author: Binay Verma
status: Registered before any parameter selection or forecast for these states; no outcome of these states has been evaluated in this project.

hypotheses.R1: SARIMAX(1,0,0)(1,0,0,7): typed-day minus pooled-day event MASE at lead 1 is NEGATIVE (typed better). Replicates H1 of osf.io/yw7mr.
hypotheses.R2: LightGBM with minimum leaf size fixed at 2: typed-day minus pooled-day event MASE at lead 1 is POSITIVE (pooled better). Replicates H3 of osf.io/yw7mr.
hypotheses.M1: Ridge: in the three states with the highest early-period absolute festival-effect dispersion (h_abs, 2015-2020 demand only: Chhattisgarh, West Bengal, Haryana), typed-day minus pooled-day lead-1 MASE over 2021-2025 is NEGATIVE.
hypotheses.M2: Across the seven states, h_abs is NEGATIVELY rank-correlated (Spearman) with the state mean Ridge typed-day minus pooled-day lead-1 MASE over 2021-2025.

reported_not_tested: ridge and lightgbm (stable) at lead 1 against the R1/R2 rule
combined first + second test: R1/R2 statistic over the 45 family-year clusters with all 14 states
power: review/new_states_v2/power/README.md: about 18-34% (R1) and 19-36% (R2) if the effect equals the first test; stated before any forecast.
test: R1, R2: per state, family and year, mean lead-1 MASE over the event cases, typed-day minus pooled-day. Cluster = family-year; cluster value = equal-weight mean over the states in that cluster. Statistic = mean over clusters. One-sided sign-flip p in the hypothesised direction, Monte Carlo with 1,000,000 sign draws (numpy default_rng seed 20261116), p = (k+1)/(N+1). M1: units = state-family-year values of Ridge typed minus pooled lead-1 MASE, 2021-2025, in the three named states; statistic = mean over units; same one-sided sign-flip (seed 20261116). M2: Spearman correlation (average ranks for ties) between h_abs and the state mean of the M1 unit values over 2021-2025, one-sided exact permutation p over all 5040 orderings of the outcome, p = share of orderings with correlation <= observed. Holm across R1, R2, M1, M2, alpha 0.05.
decision: R1, R2: CONFIRMED if the Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND the year means (each year = mean of its family-year clusters) have the hypothesised sign in at least 6 of the 9 event years. M1: CONFIRMED if the Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND the year means (2021-2025) are negative in at least 4 of 5 years. M2: CONFIRMED if the Holm-adjusted p < 0.05. CONTRADICTED (any) if the statistic has the opposite sign and its opposite-direction one-sided p < 0.05 (not Holm-adjusted). Otherwise NOT CONFIRMED.
sensitivity: Pre-declared, reported alongside without changing the decision: (a) 2020-2021 removed (COVID); (b) only rows checked by the author one by one (check_method not triage); (c) M1/M2 with the first-test h instead of h_abs.
conventions: anchors = main festival day per family and year (review/new_states_v2/DESIGN_DRAFT.md); conventions 1-6 of review/new_states_v1/DESIGN_DRAFT.md
weekend festivals stay flagged; optional-only years get no flag
case rule, frames, placebos (seed 42), regression and SARIMAX code as Stage A
cases whose label is missing or non-positive are dropped before registration
